description: hyp guards: write-once raw + journal fragments incl. a Bash mistake-net branch (PreToolUse), generic policy interpreter over operating-model policy nodes (PreToolUse), capture-intent context (UserPromptSubmit), harden-check advisory spine (cache-first, plugin-rooted) + standing rules + drift check + uncommitted-capture warning + stale-dashboard check + ledger resolver with open-decision surfacing (SessionStart), verdict-gated dispatch of the top open item + unjournaled-work backstop (Stop, dispatch at experiments profile), dashboard refresh (SessionStart + Stop), preflight gate on run-shaped commands + advisory commit backstop (PreToolUse, experiments profile), license-join advisory on rule-carrier writes — a rule write must cite a resolvable directive/incident license (PreToolUse, H-250 keep), the per-caller decision announce — one JSON object whose systemMessage is said to the person at every SessionStart source (startup|resume|clear|compact|fork), its own 10 s row, never budgeted or cached (decision-queue-projection lane, kept in the source lab) — and the ledger resolver wrapper's RESOLVER-FAILED line on an empty or non-zero reading (the same lane's disclosed amendment). Every row resolves the repository it reads and writes through hyp_config.resolve_root: the checkout the session works in (a linked worktree included), never the launch directory CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR alone (hook-writes-worktree fix). Model-routing guard (PreToolUse, matcher Workflow per .claude/hyp.json routing.enforce -- default advise -- and matcher Agent, advise-only): denies or advises on a workflow script whose agent() calls omit or misroute model/effort against the committed routing table (rules/routing-default.json merged with .claude/routing.json) -- source lab H-DRAFT-314c8d17-routing-guard, VERDICT.json evidence-sufficient promote. Routing ledger (Stop, timeout 15 s; SubagentStop, timeout 10 s -- unmeasured on real workflow agents, disclosed no-op-safe): appends one agent-route/v1 row per finished workflow agent to the worktree's ledger/routing-ledger.jsonl -- source lab H-DRAFT-38f86fad-routing-ledger-row, VERDICT.json evidence-sufficient promote.

hooks.command: python3 -S -E "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/session-start-budget.py" run dashboard-check 'python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/compile-dashboard.py" --check --hook || echo "hyp: DASHBOARD.md was stale at session start (the next hook refreshes it) — review and commit the refreshed copy."'

python3 -S -E "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/session-start-budget.py" run resolver 'out=$(python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/session_resolver.py" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$out" ]; then echo "RESOLVER-FAILED rc=$rc $([ -z "$out" ] && echo empty-reading || echo see-output) -- the ledger resolver printed nothing usable (expected only for a ledger with nothing to surface); rerun from the checkout: python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/session_resolver.py"; fi; [ -n "$out" ] && printf "%s\n" "$out" | head -40; exit 0' --also om-worker 'python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/om-worker.py" drain --boundary startup --plugin-scripts "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts"'
python3 -S -E "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/session-start-budget.py" cached harden-check recovery-warning dashboard-check resolver dashboard-refresh
